questions.q: Who was Black Beauty's new master in this chapter?
Black Beauty says "feeling is believing." What does he mean?
choices: He only truly understood a cab-horse's misery when he lived it himself
He could feel the weather changing
He believed only what people told him
questions.evidence: I never knew till now the utter misery of a cab-horse's life

questions.q: What was missing at Skinner's that Jerry always gave his horses?
questions.evidence: In this place we had no Sunday rest

questions.q: Why did Black Beauty keep doing his best even under cruel treatment?
choices: As Ginger had said, it was no use; men are the strongest
He hoped to win a prize
questions.evidence: as poor Ginger said, it was no use; men are the strongest

questions.q: What did the young girl at the station ask her father to do?
choices: Take a second cab because the horse was so weak
questions.evidence: Papa, papa, do take a second cab

questions.q: How did the blustering father answer his daughter Grace?
choices: He told her not to make a fuss and to get in
He agreed and hired a second cab
He asked the porter for advice
questions.evidence: get in at once, and don't make all this fuss

questions.q: Where did Black Beauty fall down?
questions.evidence: I got along fairly till we came to Ludgate Hill

questions.q: What helped Black Beauty come back to life after he fell?
choices: Cold water, cordial, and a kind-voiced man encouraging him
questions.evidence: a kind-voiced man was patting me and encouraging me to rise

questions.q: What did the farrier say was wrong with Black Beauty?
choices: It was overwork more than disease
He was too old to live
questions.evidence: This is a case of overwork more than disease

questions.q: Skinner said the horse "must just go to the dogs." What did he mean?
choices: Be got rid of because he was no longer useful
Go to live with some dogs
Take a holiday in the country
questions.evidence: Then he must just go to the dogs

questions.q: What changed Black Beauty's feelings at the end of the chapter?
choices: Ten days of rest and good food made him think it might be better to live
He was sent back to Jerry
questions.evidence: I began to think, after all, it might be better to live than go to the dogs
